what.en: A flood is when water covers land that is usually dry. Heavy rain or an overflowing river can make water rise fast.
what.fil: Ang baha ay kapag tinakpan ng tubig ang lupang karaniwang tuyo. Dahil sa malakas na ulan o umaapaw na ilog, maaaring tumaas agad ang tubig.

signs.en: Nonstop heavy rain, rising water in rivers and canals, and water creeping into streets. PAGASA gives Yellow, Orange, and Red rainfall warnings.
signs.fil: Tuloy-tuloy na malakas na ulan, tumataas na tubig sa ilog at kanal, at tubig na pumapasok sa kalye. Nagbibigay ang PAGASA ng Yellow, Orange, at Red rainfall warning.

before.en: Help your family move important things to a higher place. Pack a Go Bag and know the way to your evacuation center.
before.fil: Tulungan ang pamilya na iakyat ang mahahalagang gamit sa mataas na lugar. Maghanda ng Go Bag at alamin ang daan papunta sa evacuation center.

during.en: Never walk or play in floodwater! Stay indoors, evacuate when told, and don't touch anything electric if you are wet.
during.fil: Huwag kailanman maglakad o maglaro sa baha! Manatili sa loob, lumikas kapag sinabihan, at huwag humawak ng de-kuryenteng gamit kung basa ka.

after.en: Go home only when officials say it's safe. Let adults check the electricity first. Don't eat or drink anything that floodwater touched.
after.fil: Umuwi lamang kapag sinabi ng mga opisyal na ligtas na. Hayaang suriin muna ng nakatatanda ang kuryente. Huwag kainin o inumin ang anumang nadampian ng baha.

signoff.en: Remember: stay out of floodwater, always!
